tip.connecting: Signing in to Vibe with your Minecraft account…
tip.online: Signed in to Vibe: friends, chat and synced cosmetics are active.

welcome.title: Welcome to Vibey Client
welcome.body: Friends, chat, cosmetics, emotes, world hosting and more – in one client by Vibe Craft Studios. Every part is a module you can switch on or off.

online.title: Online features
online.body: Friends, chat and synced cosmetics use the Vibe backend at {0}. You sign in with your Minecraft account – no extra registration.
online.token: Sign-in uses the same check Minecraft servers use. Your Minecraft token never leaves the game.
online.data: Stored: your UUID, name, friends, chats and cosmetics – nothing else.

keys.title: Find your way
keys.menu: Opens the Vibey menu: modules and settings.
keys.pause: The pause menu has a Vibey row, the main menu small Vibey buttons in the top right corner.
keys.later: You can change keys in the Vibey menu and open this welcome again under About.

about.creditsText: Made by Vibe Craft Studios. Seal mascot, wordmark, icons and all cosmetics are original work. Thanks to everyone who tests and gives feedback.
about.privacyOn: On: Vibey talks to {0}. Sign-in uses Minecraft's own server check – your Minecraft token never leaves the game.
about.privacyOff: Off: Vibey does not connect to anything.
about.mojang: Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

general.description: Language, look and online features for the whole client.
general.offlineHint: Online features are off: Vibey doesn't connect to anything.

hud.title: HUD editor
hud.cancel.tip: Close and undo everything you changed since you opened the editor
hud.emptyHint: Open Widgets in the dock below to add some, or pick a template.
hud.hint: Drag to move · handles resize (Shift: free) · right-click for style · Ctrl+Z undo
hud.hintEmpty: Switch on a module with HUD elements (e.g. Media) to place them here.

library.title: Widgets
library.hint: Switch a widget on to put it on the screen, then drag it where you want it.

style.align.auto: Auto (follows the side it sits on)
style.anchor.tip: The point of the screen it keeps its distance to when the window size changes
style.globalNote: Every widget uses this style unless you gave it its own.
style.inherit.tip: Own value · click to use the global style again

error.tooBig: That is too long to be a HUD layout.
error.notCode: That is not a Vibey HUD share code.
error.notLayout: That code does not contain a HUD layout.
error.newer: This layout is from a newer Vibey Client. Update to use it.

import.title: Import a layout
import.hint: Paste a share code (VHUD1.…) or pick a saved file.
import.drop: Tip: drop a .vhud file on the window.

1.title: Drag anything
1.body: Grab a widget and move it. It snaps to the edges, the middle and other widgets.

2.title: Resize with the handles
2.body: Pull a corner or an edge to make it bigger. Hold Shift to change the shape freely.

3.title: Right-click for style
3.body: Colours, background, size and more. Add widgets and pick templates in the dock below.

toast.hidden: Hidden · add it back under Widgets
toast.hiddenMany: {0} hidden · add them back under Widgets

domainMove.title: Vibe is moving
domainMove.body: New addresses: vibe.axolite.app and *.axolite.cc. The old addresses keep working for now. Please keep the Vibe Launcher and Vibey Client up to date and change saved server addresses to .axolite.cc.
